summary: Iteration 48: End-to-end verification of Scheduled Maintenance (admin CRUD + public banner + validation) and Component History (per-subsystem public detail page). Backend 8/8 pytest passed. Frontend 100% — admin schedule/list/delete + end-before-start validation, public banner on /status, click-through to /status/email component page (24h/7d/90d windows, daily chart, incident history, back link), and 404 fallback for invalid keys all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: deploy_center.py is now ~1160 lines; splitting into maintenance/incidents/subscribers/status-page submodules is overdue.

scan_maintenance runs inside the 30-min _reminder_loop and sequentially awaits send_email_detailed per subscriber — under real email provider keys and >100 subscribers a single window blast can hold the loop; consider asyncio.gather with a bounded semaphore in _notify_subscribers.
public_component() rescans the entire diagnostics_history collection on every hit (up to 500 rows) — cache or pre-aggregate into a rolling document.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_iter48 maintenance window via pytest (deleted in same test), 1 TEST_UI_iter48 window via Playwright (deleted in cleanup). One pre-existing 'DB upgrade' maintenance row was observed and left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints verified: GET/POST/DELETE /api/admin/deploy/maintenance (create validates end>start -> 400 'End must be after start'; missing times -> 400; groups list includes platform/ai/calls/email). GET /api/status/public returns 'maintenance' array containing only scheduled+in_progress windows with title/message/starts_at/ends_at/state/components labels. GET /api/status/public/component/{key} works for platform/ai/calls/email (returns enabled, key, label, status, windows{24h,7d,90d}.pct, daily[], incidents[]) and 404 for unknown key. Frontend verified on /admin -> Deployment: manage-maintenance-btn opens manage-maintenance-panel; filling maint-title/message/start/end + maint-group-email + maint-lead + maint-schedule-btn produces a maint-row with 'scheduled' chip and a working maint-delete-<id>; end-before-start shows an 'End must be after start' toast and does not create a row. Public /status (no login): maintenance-banner renders inside status-maintenance with the title/message/window/component labels; status-group-<key> rows are clickable Links to /status/<key>; ComponentStatus page shows component-back, component-window-24h/7d/90d, component-daily-chart, component-incidents; /status/<invalid> shows component-unavailable. Email subscriber heads-up sending is expected to fail silently (no provider key) — not flagged.
